caseName: In re Disbarment of Bong Hyun Kim
caseNameFull: In re Disbarment of Bong Hyun Kim

opinions.text: Bong Hyun Kim, of Chicago, Ill., having requested to resign as a member of the Bar of this Court, it is ordered that his name be stricken from the roll of attorneys admitted to practice before the Bar of this Court. The rule to show cause, heretofore issued on February 26, 1979 [440 U. S. 933], is hereby discharged.
